sources.title: DariusTheGeek/waxal-joint-ctc-1b-lid · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: waxal-joint-ctc-1b-lid Joint Lingala + Shona OmniASR CTC-1B, fine-tuned without any language tag, paired with the text language-identification classifier used to route its output. This is the entry point of the WAXAL ASR solution.

sources.title: Introducing WAXAL: A New Open Dataset for African Speech Technology
sources.snippet: Google is announcing WAXAL, a new large-scale and openly accessible speech dataset for 21 Sub-Saharan African languages, designed to catalyze research and enable inclusive technologies.

sources.snippet: waxal-lin-omniasr-llm-1b OmniASR LLM-1B v2, fine-tuned for Lingala as part of the WAXAL ASR solution. Released artifact: top-3 uniform FP64 parameter average. Decoded with beam 5, length_norm=True. Files

sources.title: WAXAL: A Large-Scale Multilingual African Language Speech Corpus
sources.snippet: The WAXAL dataset represents a significant step toward addressing the resource scarcity that has hindered the development of speech technologies for Sub-Saharan African languages.

sources.title: GitHub - facebookresearch/omnilingual-asr: Omnilingual ASR Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Omnilingual ASR is an open-source speech recognition system supporting over 1,600 languages — including hundreds never previously covered by any ASR technology. Designed for broad accessibility, it enables new languages to be added with just a few paired examples without requiring specialized expertise or large datasets.
